## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:ADR-0087 处置词表段落里 `no-migration-prescription` 一句补上第二种拒收(2026-11-12 修订注,引 #32601 / PR #32649):changeset 声明 narrowed 的元数据协议种类时,不读正文直接拒收;并写明出路(登记 semantic 条目,或确实成立的有事实可核的类别)。2026-08-30 附录的类别表同一行加修订注指回该段。
- 为什么改:门禁自 PR #32649 起已这样拒收,ADR 仍只写「正文带迁移处方才拒收」;作者照 ADR 选了这个豁免,会撞上 ADR 没解释的拒收。
- 风险与回滚:只改一个 ADR 文件(+19/−6,其中 −6 是同段落为插入文字重新折行),不动门禁、词表、代码、技能;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md` 第 764 行起的处置词表段落(「amended 2026-11-12」括注),再看第 880 行类别表 `no-migration-prescription` 那一行。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --self-test && node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`,预期两者 exit 0(门禁读 ADR 的类别集合,集合不变)。
- 需要你做的:受管面 Tier H(`docs/adr/**`):请批准或合并。

## What changes

One file, `docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md` (+19 / −6). No gate, `CATEGORIES` or vocabulary change.

- **The disposition paragraph** of the 2026-08-13 addendum (`:764`). After "`no-migration-prescription` is refused by a body that carries a migration prescription" comes an inline amendment, in the ADR's own `(**amended DATE**, #card: …)` style, citing #32601, seat decision A, landed as PR #32649 (`a8c761fb`). It states the refusal as the gate makes it: refused outright, before its justification or its body is read, on a changeset that declares a `narrowed` Metadata-protocol kind (signal (5) of the breaking declaration); why (a narrowing refuses something an author used to write, and the upgrade guide and `objectstack migrate meta`, both generated from the ledger, are where an upgrading author learns it, however the fix is worded); the prescription (a `registered` semantic entry under `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/`, or `already-registered` / `unpublished` / `runtime-interface-only` / `type-surface-only` / `runtime-export-retired` when one is true; a change that refuses nothing should correct its `Metadata-protocol:` line); and the two boundaries (`added`, `semantic`, `none` keep the exemption; a changeset already breaking at the branch point is inherited). The −6 lines are the rest of the same paragraph re-wrapped around the insertion; no word of it changed.
- **The category table row** in the 2026-08-30 addendum (`:880`). The measured `refused — the body carries a FROM/TO block.` stays, and a dated note says that on a declared narrowing the category is refused before the body is read, pointing back to the paragraph above. The table is a measurement of the #12104 shape, so the note adds the second refusal without re-grading that measurement.

## Acceptance notes

The text was read from the gate on `origin/main` `ba35dfd7` (no commit after `a8c761fb` touches either file), not from the card's line numbers:

| Claim in the new text | Read from `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` |
|---|---|
| refused before the justification and body are read | `scan()`: the `NARROWED_SIGNAL` check sits after `CATEGORIES.includes` and before the 40-character `why` check and every body read |
| the trigger is a declared `narrowed` kind | `breakingDeclaration()`: `kind?.kind === 'declared' && kind.value === 'narrowed'` pushes `NARROWED_SIGNAL` |
| the reason and the fix (semantic entry, or a fact-checked category; else correct the declaration) | the refusal's own message text in `scan()`; `MIGRATION_LEDGER_ENTRY_DIRS[0]` = `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic` |
| `added` / `semantic` / `none` keep it; branch-point stock is inherited | header section "A declared narrowing owes the upgrade guide (#32601)", both bullets; the `M`/`R` inheritance branch in `scan()` |

- Premise holds: before this PR the ADR named only the body-prescription refusal (`grep -n "32601\|narrowed"` hit nothing in the disposition paragraph or the table).
- The VOCABULARY DRIFT assertion reads the ADR's marker examples (the `adr-0087: not-required (CATEGORY` comment lines); the edit adds none, and both gate runs below pass it.
- Not touched: the Status block (it lists maintainer-ruled amendments; this follows a seat decision under an existing gate), and the 2026-10-12 addendum's table (`:1078`, `admitted` for #22875's arrowless retirement lines): it records a measurement of that changeset under the gate of its day, outside the card's Ask.
